result.reasoning: This commit ("Introduce allowed keys table per API client") bumped DATABASE_VERSION from 7 to 8 and added the switch-case migration block for the new api_allowed_keys table. However, it introduced a superfluous "case 7: // consolidate" case that falls through into "case 8:" without ever being tied to an actual database version bump — effectively adding an extra, non-functional case label into the fall-through chain. This caused every subsequent case number in the switch statement to be off-by-one relative to the actual DATABASE_VERSION progression, which is precisely the "ridiculous database migration bug" that commit 45bddf5b5c2d fixes by removing the stray "case 7: // consolidate" line and renumbering all following cases down by one.
